title: What the Specification Did Not Say: Specification-Oracle Gaps in Test-Graded Coding-Agent Benchmarks
abstract: arXiv:2610.30635v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Coding-agent benchmarks often describe a task in natural language but grade it with tests taken from the upstream project. Passing those tests can require information the description never states: a constant's name, a module path, an exact message. We call this a specification-oracle gap: where it exists, a benchmark also measures whether an agent reproduces upstream implementation details. We formalise the gap, including the inconsistencies that chains of dependent tasks add, and build a static audit for five languages that classifies every name-, path- and literal-level dependency of every scored test (held-out precision 89.2%, recall 92.9%). On SWE-Milestone (98 graded milestones, 35 published runs), 25 milestones contain a test that depends on an unstated, non-inferable name or path. translated_title: 规范未言明之事：基于测试评分的编程智能体基准中的规范-预言机差距
translated_abstract: 编程智能体基准测试通常用自然语言描述任务，但使用来自上游项目的测试来评分。通过这些测试可能需要描述中从未说明的信息：一个常量的名称、一个模块路径、一条确切的消息。我们将其称为规范-预言机差距：当这种差距存在时，基准测试实际上还在衡量智能体是否能复现上游的实现细节。我们对这一差距进行了形式化定义，包括依赖任务链所引入的不一致性，并构建了一个针对五种语言的静态审计工具，对每个被评分测试的名称级、路径级和字面量级依赖进行分类（留出集精确率89.2%，召回率92.9%）。在SWE-Milestone（98个评分里程碑，35次已发布的运行）上，25个里程碑包含依赖于未说明且不可推断的名称或路径的测试。具有此类依赖的构建单元在80.6%的运行中失败，而没有此类依赖的可比单元失败率为48.4%，且隐藏单个名称便会使……
tldr: 该论文发现编程智能体基准测试中存在“规范-预言机差距”——评分测试依赖任务描述中未说明的实现细节（如常量名、模块路径），导致这类任务的智能体失败率高达80.6%（无此差距时仅48.4%），并提出了覆盖五种语言的形式化静态审计方法来检测此类差距。
en_tdlr: The paper identifies "specification-oracle gaps" in coding-agent benchmarks, where graded tests depend on unstated implementation details like constant names and module paths, causing failure rates of 80.6% versus 48.4% for comparable units, and introduces a formalized static audit method across five languages to detect these gaps with 89.2% precision and 92.9% recall.
